INTERNAL NOTES
"Elena was thrilled with the orchard view in June — she fingered fresh-cut rosemary with a smile. Worth recreating."
— Camille, 12 May 2025
"Allergic: shellfish. Confirmed with executive on Capri trip."
— Camille, 14 May 2025
On the first reply, A guest's enquiry is a doorway. Answer within the hour, in their voice if you can at all be the innkeeper.
On the small ask, A bottle of Bardol, a kettle on for tea — small kindness scales. Even a curt note compounds it for what we are.
On the silence afterward, Not every message warrants a reply. A reread email and a letter of welcome will speak for themselves.
